apr.notes: Variable APR 19.24%–29.49% for purchases (based on creditworthiness). 0% introductory APR for the first fifteen billing cycles on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening, then 19.24% to 29.49%. Balance transfer fee: $5 or 5% of each transfer, whichever is greater. APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.
